label: Bible Study
prompt: But will God indeed dwell on the earth? behold, the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot _____ thee; how much less this house that I have builded?
verse: But will God indeed dwell on the earth? behold, the heaven and heaven of heavens cannot contain thee; how much less this house that I have builded?
note: Solomon dedicates the temple and admits the obvious — heaven can't hold God, much less a building.

label: Warm-Up Word
prompt: And they rose early in the morning, and went forth into the wilderness of Tekoa: and as they went forth, Jehoshaphat stood and said, Hear me, O Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem; Believe in the LORD your God, so shall ye be established; believe his prophets, so shall ye _____.
verse: And they rose early in the morning, and went forth into the wilderness of Tekoa: and as they went forth, Jehoshaphat stood and said, Hear me, O Judah, and ye inhabitants of Jerusalem; Believe in the LORD your God, so shall ye be established; believe his prophets, so shall ye prosper.
note: Jehoshaphat's pep talk at dawn before the battle: believe God and His prophets, and ye shall prosper.

label: Sunday School
prompt: And the daughter of Pharaoh came down to wash herself at the river; and her maidens walked along by the river's side; and when she saw the ark among the _____, she sent her maid to fetch it.
verse: And the daughter of Pharaoh came down to wash herself at the river; and her maidens walked along by the river's side; and when she saw the ark among the flags, she sent her maid to fetch it.
note: The KJV says 'flags' for reeds — Pharaoh's daughter spotted the little ark tucked among them while going down to bathe.

label: Deep Water
prompt: For the which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and am _____ that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day.
verse: For the which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day.
note: Paul says 'whom,' not 'what,' I have believed — and he's sure his deposit is safe in those hands.

label: Don't Play With Me
prompt: To whom also he shewed himself alive after his passion by many _____ proofs, being seen of them forty days, and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of God:
verse: To whom also he shewed himself alive after his passion by many infallible proofs, being seen of them forty days, and speaking of the things pertaining to the kingdom of God:
note: Forty days of 'many infallible proofs' — Luke's case that the risen Jesus was no rumor.
